We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We must produce JSON route where each reaction node uses the given template_id (as integer? example uses number). Provide children as precursor molecules (type mol). The route must start from target molecule (given SMILES). Then apply first template 29646 to get precursors, then each subsequent reaction on each precursor as needed to reach final leaf nodes (starting materials). Need at least 5 reactions total, using those templates in order. So chain of 5 steps.

We attempted applying template 29646 gave three possible precursors (list of three SMILES). We need to pick one that can be further processed with next template 1914389, etc. The order must be exactly as given. So step1: apply 29646 to target, get precursors. Choose one precursor that matches template 1914389. Then apply 1914389 to that precursor, get new precursors. Then apply 1914390 to one of those, etc.

We need to find a chain where each template matches. Use apply_template tool to test.

First, we have result from 29646: three precursors:

1. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C'

2. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO'

3. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO'

We need a precursor that matches template 1914389. We tried applying 1914389 to first and got result (two precursors). Good. So we can use first precursor as step2.

From earlier: applying 1914389 to first precursor gave result: (('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),)

So two precursors: A = 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C' and B = 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'

Now step3 must use template 1914390 on one of these. We tried applying 1914390 to A earlier and got result: "(('CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1',),)" So that works. So step3: apply 1914390 to A gives precursor C = 'CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1'

Now step4 must use template 149040 on C. We tried applying 149040 to C and got no result (empty). So maybe need to apply 149040 to B instead? Let's test applying 149040 to B.
